zh.title: 庆怜 × 伦敦时装周｜让艺人形象进入城市语境
zh.summary: 以人物造型为主线，在室内与伦敦城市场景之间组织制作，让时装周亮相形成兼具服饰细节与地域辨识度的形象内容。
zh.preview: 从室内闪光灯下的丝绒造型，到贝克街地铁站的完整人物画面，场景变化扩展了同一艺人的视觉表达。形象准备与拍摄协作让这些内容共同构成伦敦叙事。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与形象准备、场景安排、人员沟通与摄影，支持庆怜在不同环境中的人物内容制作。
zh.context: 庆怜的 2025 年伦敦时装周项目发生于时尚与艺人传播交汇的节点。内容既需要呈现造型，也需要说明人物与所在城市的关系，让伦敦成为可被识别的语境，而非一个地点标签。

narrativeSections.heading: 城市是内容的一部分
narrativeSections.text: 贝克街地铁站为完整造型提供明确的城市背景，室内人物画面则将注意力集中在服饰与神态。两种环境承担不同的叙事任务，使时装周内容同时拥有地点信息与人物细节。

narrativeSections.heading: 跨场景制作的共同参照
narrativeSections.text: 场景变化意味着人物准备和制作人员需要共同面对不同环境。我们的参与覆盖形象、场景及人员沟通，以庆怜的人物呈现为参照，将准备工作带入各处拍摄。

narrativeSections.heading: 形象资产的编辑空间
narrativeSections.text: 完整造型、侧面近景与室内人物画面提供不同内容层次，可分别服务艺人介绍、造型展示与伦敦行程回顾。其商业价值在于留下有具体时尚语境的人物材料，供后续传播与合作讨论参考。

deliverables: 人物形象准备及场景安排
拍摄人员沟通与制作配合
庆怜造型近景、室内人物及城市环境影像
outcomes: 交付不同场景下的人物内容，呈现服饰细节与伦敦城市背景。
影像为艺人团队组织时装周回顾和形象内容提供多种视觉切入点。

en.title: Qinglian at London Fashion Week | The City in the Frame
en.summary: Portraits and London settings gave Qinglian’s fashion week appearance both sartorial detail and a sense of place, with image preparation carried through into production.
en.preview: An interior flash portrait and a complete look at Baker Street tell complementary stories. Preparation and shoot coordination brought those settings into one account of the artist in London.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to image preparation, settings, people liaison and photography for Qinglian’s content across different environments.
en.context: Qinglian’s 2025 London Fashion Week project sat at the meeting point of fashion and artist communication. The content needed to show the look while giving the city a visible role, making London part of the imagery rather than simply a location credit.

narrativeSections.heading: Place carries part of the story
narrativeSections.text: Baker Street station provides a specific London setting for a complete look. Interior portraits bring attention back to clothing and expression. The environments do different editorial work, giving the set both a geographic context and personal detail.

narrativeSections.heading: One subject across different settings
narrativeSections.text: Moving between environments places demands on talent preparation and the people producing the images. Our contribution covered image, settings and liaison, carrying the preparation into each part of the shoot around the same subject.

narrativeSections.heading: Room for different editorial uses
narrativeSections.text: Complete looks, profile details and interior portraits offer material for talent introductions, styling features and London recaps. The value is a set of images situated within a fashion moment, available as a reference for later communication and collaboration discussions.

deliverables: Qinglian detail portraits, interior looks and city imagery
outcomes: The delivered content presents clothing details alongside recognisable London surroundings.
The imagery gives the talent team several visual entry points for fashion week recaps and artist content.
